narrative.overview: edurec is a Chinese educational-resource recommender. Its interface is a fresh, quiet study desk: cool mint paper, deep forest ink, one jade pen. The home hero puts a real recommendation card on the desk, not an illustration; every page answers what to learn next and why. The earlier transit-signage and cream/terracotta worlds are replaced by a light mint-and-jade system in Operate mode.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mint paper ground with white cards and deep forest-green ink.
One jade signal for action and current state.
Softer editorial scale with self-hosted Manrope and the system Chinese stack.
10px fields, 14px cards, 16px panels; pills only for chips and small controls.
Borders at rest, one green-tinted hover lift, no ambient card shadows.
Pale jade tinted mastheads instead of dark bands.
Asymmetric light auth split instead of a 1:1 dark poster.
A fixed four-destination bottom tab bar on mobile.
rules: One Signal Rule: jade means act here or you are here; never a page wash or gradient.
Meaningful Color Rule: level/type colors only where they encode level, type, or state.
No-Eyebrow Rule: no decorative kicker or uppercase label above a heading.
Tinted Masthead Rule: orientation panels are pale jade; deep ink is not a full-width band.
Flat-by-default Rule: elevation is a hover response, not ambient decoration.
dos: Keep the mint paper / white / forest ink split and generous section spacing.
Use one jade signal and semantic level colors only where meaningful.
Use Manrope for Latin/numerals and tabular numerals for data.
Give every empty and error state a clear next action.
Keep keyboard focus rings and reduced-motion support.
donts: Do not reintroduce transit signage: navy rail bands, 2px route strokes, station dots, uppercase micro-labels, 4px corners.
Do not go back to cream + terracotta.
Do not use gradient text, glass decoration, or colored halos.
Do not put a kicker above a heading.
Do not use pills for large containers or buttons.
Do not use ambient shadows on static cards.
Do not convey state by color alone.
